resources.string: Home LAN access determines the listener bind address.
Use Home basic settings when LAN devices need the proxy listener.
With LAN access off, listeners bind locally. This field is owned by Home.
bind-address
Control when the core looks up process information for connections.
The default is strict: look up processes when a rule requires it.
Android restricts some process information. Always looking up does not bypass system restrictions.
find-process-mode
The HTTP listener port is selected through Home listener type and port.
Use it for clients that connect to an HTTP proxy explicitly.
Android VPN does not require a manual system proxy. This field is removed when HTTP is not the selected listener type.
port
The SOCKS listener port is selected through Home listener type and port.
Use it for clients that connect to a SOCKS proxy explicitly.
This field is removed when SOCKS is not selected. The mixed listener uses mixed-port.
socks-port
Set UDP forwarding for every compatible node.
Use it to allow or disable UDP consistently across nodes.
Only compatible protocols are modified. This does not add UDP support to a server.
proxies.*.udp
Set TCP Fast Open for every compatible node.
Use it when the server and network support TCP Fast Open.
It may have no effect on unsupported systems or servers. Disabling the field preserves source values.
proxies.*.tfo
Set multipath TCP for every compatible node.
Use it when the network and server support multipath TCP.
This setting does not replace operating-system and server MPTCP support.
proxies.*.mptcp
Set a TLS client fingerprint for compatible nodes.
Use it when the server expects a particular TLS fingerprint.
Only supported protocols are modified. A fingerprint does not guarantee undetectable traffic.
proxies.*.client-fingerprint
Choose the upstream dialer proxy used by compatible nodes.
Use an existing proxy or selector to reach the next hop.
The target must exist and must not create a cycle. References are checked before saving.
proxies.*.dialer-proxy
Set the IPv4/IPv6 preference when compatible nodes connect to their servers.
Use it when one IP stack is unavailable or should be preferred.
This affects server connections, not application DNS results. Home still controls global IPv6.
proxies.*.ip-version
